purpose: Refer formally to any kind of person, thing, or circumstance.
keywords: いかなる + N + も / negative / condition
Violence is unacceptable for any reason.
We will give advance notice of any change.
formation: いかなる + N + も / negative / condition
restrictions: Usually broadens the statement to all possible cases.
mistake: It modifies a noun; use いかに for degree or manner.
